summary.text: Sydney Jordan is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 60A, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2020, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Republican John Holmberg is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Jordan's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Education Policy Committee (as Co-Chair), the Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy Committee and the Rules and Legislative Administration Committee.
